records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our Subscription revenue increased primarily due to continued customer cloud adoption of our solutions delivered via the cloud and an increase in on-premise license demand, mostly from our App Delivery and Security offerings.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Deferred revenues decreased $99.5 million as of March 31, 2022 compared to December 31, 2021 primarily due to decreases in deferred maintenance and support revenue of $63.6 million, mostly from Workspace perpetual software maintenance, and deferred subscription revenue of $35.9 million.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We incurred $20.1 million of expenses related to the Wrike acquisition, of which $0.3 million and $15.5 million were expensed during the three months ended March 31, 2022 and 2021, respectively, and are included in General and administrative expense in the accompanying condensed consolidated statements of income.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Also, operating cash flows increased $62.1 million to $274.9 million when comparing the three months ended March 31, 2022 to the three months ended March 31, 2021.
